symbols.name: side wire
symbols.meaning: The scratch wire of an ordered neighbouring pair $(S,T)$.
symbols.quote: For each ordered neighbouring pair $(S,T)$, write $\delta_{ST}$ for the side wire of that pair, a scratch wire.

symbols.name: central wire
symbols.meaning: The scratch wire attached to the element $e$ of $[h]$.
symbols.quote: For each element $e$ of $[h]$, write $C_e$ for the central wire of $e$, also a scratch wire.

relations.quote: The bit network is a binary instance of [linear networks and frames](linear-network-frames.md): its wires carry scalars of $\mathbb F_2$, the field with two elements, 0 and 1, in which addition is exclusive or and multiplication is AND.

The bit network realises a [binary change of basis](binary-change-of-basis.md) on its wire values, since every gate is a composition of row additions, each of which adds the bit at one position into another position.
